title: AEIB Shared Incident Evidence Schema v1.1
description: Standardized schema for structured incident-evidence records separating model behavior, execution authority, and observed consequence planes under strict enums and fail-closed validation.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for the incident evidence record.

schema_version.description: Pinned version of this shared incident evidence schema.

disclaimer.const: AEIB exports structured incident evidence. The customer’s authorized incident-management and legal functions determine classification, causation, reportability, and any regulatory submission.

reproducibility_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest over the reproducible execution bundle or manifest, or null if uncomputed.

exported_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the evidence record was generated.

proposal_digest.description: SHA-256 digest over RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the raw proposed candidate action.

model_or_agent_version.description: Declared model identifier or agent framework runtime version.

input_context_digest.description: SHA-256 digest over prompt / input context, or null if context was streaming.

untrusted_content_references.description: References to external unverified inputs or retrieved content.

execution_authority.description: Plane 2: Authorization and standing evaluation plane.

governing_authority_id.description: Identifier of the root human principal or governing authority grant, or null if missing.

authority_revocation_state.description: Explicit standing state of the governing authority grant at evaluation millisecond Tn.

policy_epoch.description: Active policy epoch evaluated at boundary decision.

delegation_chain_digest.description: SHA-256 digest over the verified delegation chain, or null if direct grant.

rejection_code.description: Standardized boundary rejection code if verdict is DENIED or HELD.

observed_consequence.description: Plane 3: Observed transport and reconciliation outcome plane.

dispatch_intent_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of signed DISPATCH_INTENT journal entry, or null if blocked pre-dispatch.

target_evidence.description: Authenticated target status response under versioned contract (e.g. refund_status_v1).

reconciliation_result.description: Outcome of out-of-band target probe reconciliation.

final_disposition.description: Terminal disposition: NOT_DISPATCHED, EFFECT_INDETERMINATE, RESOLVED_CONFIRMED, RESOLVED_REFUTED, or DISPATCH_COMPLETED.
